author: rdc-rfc1-author-a (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: A two-stage chain on clk releases the counter's asynchronous clear.

author_reading.rationale: A two-stage chain on one clock releases the counter's asynchronous clear, synchronised to the single clock.

labels.rationale: rst_sync is a 2-stage synchroniser on clk from rst_n, and cnt is released by its last stage. ev and rst_n carry input delays.
The counter sees the second stage of an asynchronous-assert, synchronous-release chain. Its event enable is constrained to the counter clock.
